creator.description:
(Mostly operational, tagging still inop)

Label service that differentiates from authentic NHL accounts and those who are impersonating on what would otherwise be a teams handle. Also handles verification of NHL staff and team employees.

Run by @bdogz.xyz

locales.description: An NHL team account that is verified through their domain, verification status, or otherwise.
locales.name: Official NHL Account

locales.description: An NHL account that is not authenticated, and is otherwise name squatting, impersonating the team, or otherwise not officially the team the account claims to represent.
locales.name: Fake NHL Account

locales.description: An NHL account that is confirmed to be run by an employee of the NHL.
locales.name: Official NHL Employee

locales.description: An account that is confirmed to be run by an employee of an NHL team.
locales.name: Official NHL Team Employee

locales.description: A mirror of the X/Twitter feed of an NHL team posted to Bluesky using a bot.
locales.name: NHL Team Mirror

locales.description: A mirror of the X/Twitter feed of an NHL official posted to Bluesky using a bot.
locales.name: NHL Official Mirror

locales.description: A Bluesky user who maintains an NHL team or official mirror bot.
locales.name: NHL Mirror Creators

locales.description: An NHL account that has not been confirmed to be authentic or not.
locales.name: Unconfirmed NHL Account
